summary: Pass 50 promotes the broad Classic world-reset/cleanup assertion from UNKNOWN to STRONG by separating recovered owner-specific maintenance/reset behavior from Reforged's generic reset-plan coordinator. Native WCCMMUD ownership exports, exact SYSOP RESET/INITIALIZE forms, live Classic cleanup effects, limited static-placement restoration, invasion cleanup, and room-entry NPC respawn admission establish a substantial executable boundary. Universal category ordering, hard-reset exception encoding, active-player/combat behavior, corpse survival, Remove@Maint's distinct meaning, reset-versus-cleanup same-boundary ordering, and transactional failure/rollback semantics remain unresolved and fail closed.
classificationPolicy: Owner-specific effects with retained native/database evidence may execute and receive parity credit. Generic numeric plan order, hard-reset exclusion flags, and rollback policy are Reforged coordination semantics only and must not be treated as Classic MajorMUD evidence.
